You can find the quantized version of Cohere Labs Command-R using bitsandbytes here . Model Summary Cohere Labs Command-R is a research release of a 35 billion parameter highly performant generative model. Command-R is a large language model with open weights optimized for a variety of use cases including reasoning, summarization, and question answering. Command-R has the capability for multilingual generation evaluated in 10 languages and highly performant RAG capabilities.
